summary: The pass-1 fix (217ab66a3) says that when source names your row but enabled, reason or set_by differ, another operator changed the switch after your request and the PUT must not be repeated. set_kill_switch is a single INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (plugin_config_store.cpp 581-588), so a failed write leaves the earlier row and the read-back shows exactly that state. An emergency stop, or an enable of a default-off plugin, is left undone while the text says someone else owns the state. Same text in the served 500 description (rest_api_v1.cpp 2635) and the changelog bullet. Reported independently by docs-writer, unhappy-path, security-guardian, consistency-auditor and happy-path.
classification_rationale: the text asserts a cause the code does not establish; the GET cannot tell a failed write from a later concurrent write. Introduced by the fix round for G6167G8-KS-REPEAT-PUT.
